source: Curated from ashram/trust primary sources + Tamil panchang calendars; fixed Gregorian dates for modern siddhars, Tamil solar tMonth+nakshatra for classical observances. Cross-checked via Drik Panchang / Prokerala Tamil calendar for tMonth alignment.
note: Siddhar/ Mahaan layer — the true purpose of this calendar. Kinds: nakshatra = Tamil solar month + moon nakshatra at sunrise (engine festivalMatches); fixed = Gregorian month/day (direct). Engine checks both. TN-curated; other regions disclaimer applies (see tn_bbox).

entries.name: Seshadri Swamigal Jayanthi
entries.source: Paramporul / TiruvarunaMahan ashram table — Jayanthi Thai Hastham (birth Hastham, 22-01-1870); sriseshadriswamigalashramam.org: birthday on Thai Hastham
entries.note: Born Kanchipuram, Hastha nakshatra; annual abhishekam at Seshadri Ashram, Tiruvannamalai.

entries.name: Seshadri Swamigal Aradhana (Mahasamadhi)
entries.source: Paramporul / TiruvarunaMahan — Aradhana Margazhi Hastham; sssss-sangam.org: Mahasamadhi 04-01-1929 (Margazhi Hastham) at Tiruvannamalai, witnessed by Ramana Maharshi
entries.note: Aradhana/Samadhi anniversary observed Margazhi Hastham; thousands attend Tiruvannamalai ashram.

entries.name: Yogi Ramsuratkumar Jayanthi
entries.source: yogiramsuratkumarashram.org + Wikipedia — Born 01-12-1918 Nardara (Ballia, UP) near Kashi; ashram celebrates Dec 1 + first Sat-Sun of January grand utsav
entries.note: Disciple of Aurobindo / Ramana / Papa Ramdas (mantra Om Sri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram); beggar-saint of Tiruvannamalai from 1959.

entries.name: Yogi Ramsuratkumar Aradhana
entries.source: yogiramsuratkumarashram.org / Dinamalar temple page — Shed mortal coil 20-02-2001, Masi Dwadashi (Krishna paksha); Dinamalar lists 'Dwadasi in Masi is celebration day'
entries.note: Aradhana observed Feb 20; ashram open 06:00-12:00 & 17:00-20:00 with abhishekam & annadhanam.

entries.name: Kodi Swamigal Gurupooja (Siddhi day)
entries.source: kodiswamigal.com/ gurupoojai pages — Shed body 11-10-1994 Tuesday, Purattasi Ashtami Thithi at Puravipalayam palace terrace; siddhargalthiruvadi.com: Oct 10/11 annual at Puravipalayam Jamin, Pollachi Tk, Coimbatore
entries.note: Gurupoojai on Purattasi Ashtami thithi (Thabovanam Chennai) + Oct 11 Siddhi day at Puravipalayam Brindavanam; terrace abode 1964-1994.

entries.name: Ramana Maharshi Jayanthi
entries.source: Sri Ramanasramam / Hindu-Blog / Arunachala timeline — Born past midnight 29-12-1879 (recorded 30-12-1879), Margazhi Punarvasu (Arudra Darshan); Jayanthi annually Margazhi Punarvasu; e.g. 04-01-2026 Margazhi Punarvasu 146th/147th Jayanthi
entries.note: Celebrated at Ramanasramam with Veda parayanam, Upadesa Saram, Aksharamanamalai & girivalam.

entries.name: Ramana Maharshi Aradhana (Mahanirvana)
entries.source: Ramana timeline (Arunachala org) — Mahanirvana 14-04-1950 at Ramanasramam; annual Aradhana observed April 14-15 (Chithirai)
entries.note: 76th Aradhana 15-04-2026 per Ramanalayam; coincides with Tamil New Year window.

entries.name: Pamban Swamigal Gurupooja
entries.source: Wikipedia / pambanswamigal.net — Samadhi 30-05-1929 07:15 at Tiruvanmiyur, Chennai; annual Gurupooja May/June at samadhi (e.g. 06-06-2026 97th Gurupooja per Arulvazhi YouTube); temple notes Vaikasi
entries.note: Murugan devotee, 6666 poems; samadhi shrine Tiruvanmiyur with daily silent Aka Pooja tradition.

entries.name: Pattinathar Guru Pooja
entries.source: Dinamalar temple 53 / DivineGuide Pattinathar Temple — 'Uthirada Star, pujas on star days; Guru Puja on Uthiradam star day following full moon in Aadi (July-Aug)' at Tiruvottriyur seaside samadhi
entries.note: Seaside linga shrine, Tiruvottriyur; observed as Aadi Uthiradam Pournami-adjacent — engine shows Aadi Uthiradam flag.

entries.name: Kanchi Maha Periyava Jayanthi
entries.source: Kamakoti.org calendar + Hindu — Born Vaikasi Anusham 20-05-1894 (Jaya varusham, Vaikasi 8); annual Jayanthi Vaikasi Anusham (e.g. 31-05-2026 133rd; 03-06-2023 Vaikasi Anusham Mahaperiyava & Thiruvalluvar)
entries.note: 68th Pontiff Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam (1907-1994); shared Jayanthi with Thiruvalluvar.

entries.name: Kanchi Maha Periyava Aradhana
entries.source: Kamakoti.org / Mahendramangalam biography — Siddhi 08-01-1994 Saturday at Kanchipuram; annual Paramaguru Aaradhana Jan 8 per Kamakoti calendar 2023-24
entries.note: Anusham Jayanthi + Jan 8 Aaradhana are the two principal Maha Periyava observances.

entries.name: Annamalai Swami Aradhana
entries.source: sriannamalaiswami.org/mahasamadhi — Mahasamadhi 09-11-1995 04:45 at Palakothu samadhi shrine, Tiruvannamalai (next to Ramanasramam); annual Aradhana Nov 9 with Ribhu Gita chanting
entries.note: Served Ramana 1928-1950 as construction manager/attendant; instructed to stay put — 'That is your sadhana.'

entries.name: Maha Avatar Babaji Jayanthi
entries.source: babajiskriyayoga.net/about-babaji + Wikipedia Mahavatar Babaji + arunraj.org/mahavatar-babaji — Born 30-11-203 CE Parangipettai (Swethanathapuram), Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, Rohini nakshatra, Karthigai Deepam (Tamil month Karthigai, Rohini); disciple of Bhogar (Bogar), birth name Nagarajan; temple at Parangipettai observes Nov 30 + Karthigai Rohini
entries.note: Immortal Kriya Yoga reviver; guru of Lahiri Mahasaya (Yogananda Autobiography); Karthigai Rohini = tMonth 7 / val 3 in Siddhar table, but civil anchor is Nov 30 fixed.

entries.name: Bhogar Siddhar Jayanthi
entries.source: agathiyarvanam.blogspot.com 13-06-2015 Bhogar's Jayanthi Vaikasi Barani + Jothishi.com 18 Siddhars + lionmayura.org 28-05-2022 Vaikasi Bharani — Bhogar born Vaikasi Bharani (300 yrs 18 days, Samadhi Palani); siddharpulippanitradition.org + palani.org/bhogar
entries.note: Disciple of Kalanginathar; created Palani Navapashana Murugan idol (4448 herbs, Nava Bashanam); samadhi inside Palani Murugan temple southwestern corridor.

entries.name: Pulipani Siddhar Gurupooja
entries.source: siddharpulippanitradition.org/pulippani-tradition + palani.org/bhogar-life — Disciple of Bhogar, helped collect 9-herb Nava Bashanam for Palani idol by riding tiger; lineage at Pulipani Ashram, Adivaram, Palani; exact stellar birth not separately published in 18-Siddhar table (Bhogar is listed, Pulipani as heir not), Ashram festivals page marks Siddhar Guru Pooja collectively — observed during Vaikasi Bharani week alongside guru Bhogar
entries.note: Seven generations of Pulipani heirs (Sivananda Pulipani Pathira Swamigal, 13th) maintain Bhogar samadhi + Maragatha Lingam + Bhuvaneshwari yantra at Palani; co-observance with Bhogar on Vaikasi Bharani.

entries.name: Gorakhnath Jayanthi
entries.source: nepalipatro.com / pavitrajyotish.com Guru Gorakhnath Jayanti + Wikipedia Goraksha — Jayanti on Vaishakh Shukla Purnima (Purnima of Vaishakh, Shukla Paksha); Gorakhpur + Nepal Gorkha district named after him; disciple of Matsyendranath; also observed on Magh/Karthigai Trayodashi by some sects
entries.note: Founder of Nath Sampradaya / Kanphata Yogis; Hatha Yoga, Rot Mahotsav at Gorkha cave on Baisakh Purnima (700 yrs).

entries.name: Matsyendranath Jayanthi (Machamuni)
entries.source: hindupad.com/macchindranath-jayanti 2024-09-08 Bhadrapada Shukla Panchami + Wikipedia Matsyendranatha — Founder of Hatha Yoga / Nath Sampradaya, guru of Gorakhnath; Jeeva Samadhi at Kasi Viswanathar Temple, Thiruparankundram, Madurai (as Machamuni); also revered in Nepal as Avalokiteśvara
entries.note: Fl. 7th–12th c (Narendra Deva 640–683 vs Jnaneshwar 12th c); swallowed by fish legend (Matsya), received Kaula teachings from Shiva; 84 Mahasiddhas, 9 Naths.
